title: Display the receipt generation result after half a second
goal: Use setTimeout to schedule a delay callback that is executed only once after clicking.
summary: User clicks "Generate receipt" to see that it is being processed first. After half a second, it changes to the completion prompt and restores the button.
tasks: keeps the initial text of the page "waiting to be generated". Displays "Generating receipt" when "Generate receipt" is clicked, with the button temporarily disabled.
Use setTimeout in the click processing function to schedule 500ms before calling showReceipt.
Confirm "receipt has been generated" appears half a second later, and the button can be clicked again.

example.note: The prompt to refresh the index appears after 800ms. The first parameter of setTimeout is a function to be executed later, and the second parameter is the number of milliseconds.

hint: Pass showReceipt as a function. Written as showReceipt(), it will be called immediately, and the waiting prompt will flash by.
